svg.title: The serving engine's additions in five rounds
svg.desc: In panel a, each scenario's replies over their round's SLO in 5 rounds, v1.14's configuration to deploy and the same with the first four of version 1.15's additions to the engine, the rounds pooled with the rounds' range, against the requirement of at most 5%, and in panel b the agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s, the median of the rounds with their range: 24 agent sessions, 2 callers, v1.14's configuration to deploy 10, 13, 10, 6, 16 by round, 55 of 295 in all, at 3,010 agents' tokens a second (2,720 to 3,275), the same with the first four additions 7, 1, 4, 4, 0 by round, 16 of 295 in all, at 2,933 agents' tokens a second (2,692 to 3,221); 24 agent sessions, 4 callers, v1.14's configuration to deploy 19, 25, 29, 12, 25 by round, 110 of 595 in all, at 2,753 agents' tokens a second (2,548 to 3,062), the same with the first four additions 5, 10, 9, 6, 8 by round, 38 of 595 in all, at 2,754 agents' tokens a second (2,508 to 2,947); 24 agent sessions, 6 callers, v1.14's configuration to deploy 23, 56, 27, 29, 29 by round, 164 of 910 in all, at 2,580 agents' tokens a second (2,415 to 2,888), the same with the first four additions 3, 20, 10, 9, 11 by round, 53 of 910 in all, at 2,476 agents' tokens a second (2,215 to 2,780); 16 agent sessions of the whole corpus, 2 callers, v1.14's configuration to deploy 5, 3, 3, 9, 2 by round, 22 of 295 in all, at 4,948 agents' tokens a second (4,633 to 8,364), the same with the first four additions 2, 2, 1, 5, 0 by round, 10 of 295 in all, at 4,900 agents' tokens a second (4,666 to 9,034).
